latest_release.name: v1.0.0
latest_release.body: Blog post: https://huggingface.co/blog/ggml-org/llama-cpp-v1 ## Overview llama.cpp v1.0.0 removes the deprecated public API and promotes the NextN/speculative API to `llama.h`, adds OCP FP8 KV caches, a host-memory MoE expert cache with a configurable CPU share, and loading of external PLE shards. It adds three text architectures (Kimi-K3.1-Pro, Ripple and xing4_0), drama-3 TTS, and MageVL-Cowork and Kimi-K3.1 vision, hardens `llama-server` (SSRF, CORS, DNS rebinding, MCP tool cancellation) and adds a `/v1/audio/speech` endpoint, ships a redesigned web UI with chat groups and a markdown editor, and updates `ggml` to v1.0.0. ### API changes - llama.h: remove `llama_set_warmup`, 35 deprecated functions, `defrag_thold` and `--defrag-thold` ([#30565](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30565)) - llama.h: promote the NextN API from `llama-ext.h` and rename `llama_set_embd_state_src` to `llama_set_ctx_state_src` ([#30565](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30565)) - llama.h: add `moe_cache_size` and `moe_cache_cpu_share` to `llama_context_params` ([#30966](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30966)) - mtmd.h: add `MTMD_GEN_AUDIO_TYPE_DRAMA3` and `temp` in `mtmd_helper_gen_audio_inp` ([#31613](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31613), [#31655](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31655)) - mtmd-helper.h: add `mtmd_helper_resampler` for streaming raw PCM at the model sample rate ([#31964](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31964)) - server: add the OpenAI-compatible `/v1/audio/speech` endpoint and a `temperature` option for `/tts` ([#31763](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31763), [#31655](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31655)) ### New models - Kimi-K3.1-Pro: K3 with the full-attention MLA layers replaced by DSA ([#31779](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31779)) - Ripple-65B-Preview (`ricursive`): new dense 65B architecture, no new ops ([#31692](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31692)) - xing4_0: mHC, MLA, MoE and MTP ([#31589](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31589)) - drama-3 TTS (fishaudio) ([#31613](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31613)) ### Core changes - FP8 KV caches (`-ctk/-ctv f8_e4m3`) with optional static per-tensor scales ([#28392](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/28392)) - MoE cache: CPU share for misses, LRFU/ClassLRU replacement, no CPU wait on cached experts ([#30966](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30966), [#31233](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31233), [#31888](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31888)) - external PLE/engram loading from separate GGUF shards via `--shard`/`--ple` ([#31185](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31185)) - Windows unbuffered model load, mirroring the Linux DirectIO path ([#26014](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/26014)) - reuse the backend scheduler and graph results across reserves, and skip unused graph metadata pages ([#32009](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/32009), [#32089](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/32089), [#32043](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/32043)) - mark every sampling chain as a graph output to prevent output aliasing ([#32015](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/32015)) - remove the non-fused GDN paths and the ubatch-dependent graph node budget ([#32078](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/32078)) - store the MTP conv snapshots of every recurrent model in one `set_rows` ([#31660](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31660)) - per-model `build_rope` with a KV-shifting fix and tests ([#31683](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31683)); the model is a member of `llm_graph_context` ([#31733](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31733)) -
